incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hotpath-inference.p99 > 1200ms (eu-west) for 5m. PagerDuty incident created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345 — affected route: /v1/generate (model: redwood-xxl). Tags: region:eu-west, severity:major
Maria: saw the alert, pinging oncall. any immediate customer reports?
Ajay: Acked on PD, I'm on it. I'll check autoscaler, kv-cache metrics, and GPU memory.
Ajay: running quick `kubectl` checks now:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference --selector=app=hotpath -o wide
# pod hotpath-34 stalled, rest are spiking cpu
```
Sam: noticed a spike in backend tail latency and KV cache evictions ~5:03 UTC, looks like cache thrash after a burst of long prompts. cause: pinning issue? graphs: https://metrics.example/d/abcd/hotpath
Ajay: seeing repeated `OOMKilled` in logs for hotpath-34, but other pods fine. posting logs:```
[2024-06-18T05:03:12Z] WARN kvcache: evicting prefix 0x1a2b
[2024-06-18T05:03:13Z] ERROR runtime: gpu-mem pressure 92%
```
Maria: customer-impact dashboard shows 14 sessions with p99 > 1.2s, a couple of premium customers in eu-west. putting note in PD.
pagerduty: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by Ajay at 2024-06-18T05:05:10Z. Escalation policy: none triggered.
Ajay: short plan: 1) divert small % traffic to fallback smaller model 2) scale up hotpath pool by +2 nodes 3) enable prefix caching on longer prompts. executing step 1 now.
Ajay: running command: `infractl route set --service hotpath --region eu-west --policy gradual --fallback model-small-v2 --pct 10`
Sam: I'll bubble up an emergency scale: `k8s scale deployment/hotpath --replicas=10 -n inference` — doing now. watch autoscaler oscillation.
Maria: tagging product + support so we have customer comms ready if impact persists @Priya
Priya: thanks. which customers? can we queue pro-active emails?
Ajay: list from dashboard: AcmeCorp, FinApps, StudyBuddy. impact: slower responses but no 5xxs. I'll add a note for support to DM these customers.
Ajay: after traffic diversion p99 dropped to ~780ms at 05:12 UTC (from 1250ms). continuing to monitor.
Sam: GPUs on newly scaled nodes are showing healthy, but I still see KV eviction rate elevated. suspect a burst pattern, need to tune ttl.
Maria: any indication of a deploy around the spike window?
Ajay: checked deploy history — no canary deploys in last hour. likely workload change.
Ajay: reconfiguring autoscaler cooldown to 60s to avoid oscillation. command: `infractl autoscale set hotpath --cooldown 60s --max 20`
incident-bot: PD note updated: Mitigation steps applied (traffic fallback + scale-up). Monitoring for 30m.
Priya: support notified customers via DM, included suggested workaround (reduce max tokens) and apology.
Ajay: observed stable p95 ~220ms and p99 trending down to 400-600ms. will keep the fallback in place for 30m then ramp down if stable.
Sam: filing an action item: investigate KV cache eviction root cause and TTL tuning. putting PRD ticket: INF-4872.
Maria: good. prepare handoff: I'm taking next oncall in 25m, Ajay can handoff. Ajay pls summarize what's live and what to keep an eye on.
Ajay: Handoff summary:
- Incident: PD12345 p99 latency spike hotpath eu-west 05:03–05:30 UTC
- Impact: elevated p99 up to 1.25s for ~15-20k requests, ~14 sessions impacted (includes premium customers)
- Mitigation applied: 10% traffic reroute to `model-small-v2`, scaled hotpath pool +2 nodes, autoscaler cooldown set to 60s
- Current status: p99 420ms, p95 210ms, no 5xxs. KV evictions elevated, follow-up ticket INF-4872 assigned to Sam.
- Next steps for oncall: monitor p99, rollback traffic fallback if stable for 30m, coordinate with Sam on cache tuning, communicate RCA to support + product.
Maria: thanks Ajay — I acknowledge and will take ownership for the next 2 hours. leaving note in PD. :thumbsup:
pagerduty: Incident PD12345 reassigned to Maria at 2024-06-18T05:30:15Z.
Ajay: leaving one more note — revert autoscaler cooldown after stabilization to previous value (10s) to avoid over-provisioning cost.
Maria: noted. I'll keep monitoring and will start an RCA doc after stable. good job team. :party_parrot:
incident-bot: Incident PD12345 status: monitoring (resolved=false). Follow-up ticket INF-4872 created.
